notes.title: Screen Resize And Full Screen Patch
notes.notes: We've just released a patch to enable window re-sizing and full screen option. Full Screen option is available in Settings game menu (NOT ALT+ENTER which is unfortunately hard to fix currently).

notes.title: Game Release
notes.notes: We're excited to finally release Idle Bouncer here on Steam! Enjoy the game and leave your feedback on what you like and what you don't like! Have fun!
